correctness.rationale: For base-four A digits 0,1 and B=2A, exact counts on a full [4^k,4^(k+1)) block use lower-digit empirical Cantor CDFs F_k. Coupling finite/infinite independent base-four bits gives uniform |F_k-F|<=2^-k; the ratio converges uniformly to a bounded-variation piecewise profile. Riemann summation yields Lipschitz test error <=L(4*2^-k+2*4^-k). Two rational profile branches yield 2/y^2 dy with mass 2/3; complementary Cantor gaps each map diffeomorphically under phi(u)=(1+F(u))/(1+u), giving explicit nonnegative density correction of total mass 1/3, support exactly [1,3/2] with no atoms. Independently verified exact digit counts across k<=6, uniqueness and 12 finite gap-mass formulas. Infinite density and convergence rely on analysis, not finite trials.
